args.content:
Hawaii Packing List

Based on your vacation itinerary (June 10-20, 2024), here's your complete packing list:

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (multiple pieces for beach days and water activities)
- Sunscreen (high SPF for tropical sun protection)
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike)
- Casual outfits (for shopping and daily activities)
- Camera (to capture memories)
- Travel documents (passport, tickets, reservations)

Activity-Specific Items:
- Beach day at Waikiki Beach: Beach towel, flip flops, sunglasses
- Snorkeling at Hanauma Bay: Snorkel gear (can rent there), water shoes
- Hiking at Diamond Head: Hiking boots, water bottle, hat
- Pearl Harbor visit: Comfortable walking shoes, respectful attire
- North Shore road trip: Light jacket, snacks
- Luau experience: Hawaiian shirt/dress, camera
- Spa day: Robe (usually provided), flip flops
- Kayaking at Kailua Beach: Quick-dry clothes, water shoes
- Shopping at Ala Moana: Comfortable shoes, extra luggage space

Additional Recommendations:
- Light rain jacket (for tropical showers)
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit
- Phone charger and portable battery
- Reusable water bottle
- Light layers for air-conditioned places
